purpose: New small positive-only test of frozen v4.0, not full acceptance or false-positive validation.
selection: Named known eclipsers/pulsators selected before inspecting their TESS flux; exact VSX identity, nearest TIC within10 arcsec, exclude all previous TICs, earliest/latest standard non-fast SPOC observations by t_min. Keep unavailable cases; no replacement.
scoring: Final adjudicated photometric period vs pre-acquired catalogue period,1% relative tolerance; half/double wrong; unavailable/abstained retained in total6. Reference values not passed to analysis.
post_test_policy: Do not tune on these outcomes in this turn. Any later tuning makes these development cases.
